correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the argument from the same-object Mori cone and the surface restrictions. The (1,1) scroll is the graph of the pencil through q0; choosing six general plane points first makes the open set nonempty, and no second (1,1) section can pass through the five lifted points because its restriction would be a conic through all six. On its blow-up the six null conics have pairwise intersection zero and self-intersection -1. An irreducible null curve different from them would have a class in their nonnegative span yet meet each nonnegatively, forcing every coefficient to vanish. For a null curve outside S, S·A_i=0 and S·B_i=-1 force a class in the A_i span, hence a vertical curve; exceptional-plane curves have positive anticanonical degree and only the five special strict fibers are null. The fibers are disjoint from S and one another. The sixth conic class is the average of the five A_i+B_i expressions, hence in the relative interior of the face and nonextremal. The strict fibers have normal O(-1)^2 from blowing up one point of a fiber; for each conic the two degree -1 terms in the normal sequence split because H^1(O)=0. Basepoint freeness and the connected-fiber construction give the birational small contraction; the local contraction of O(-1)^2 yields a node. Disjointness and connected fibers give distinct nodes; normality and birationality give an isomorphism outside the listed fibers. The resulting Cartier canonical class is crepant, with ample negative and volume 14. The frozen symbolic interpolation is supplementary, not evidence of completeness or local analytic type.

originality.rationale: Pass for the explicit complete geometric locus and eleven-node analytic basket. The older same-object work materially covers the scroll, the entire cone and even the numerical decomposition of the sixth conic, not the geometric exhaustiveness or analytic contraction type. Those require ruling out curves represented by nonextremal classes, then computing normal bundles and separating images; a ray census is not that classification.
residual_risks: An unindexed classical classification or a differently presented genus-8 model with the same resolution may state this basket; the broader and narrower searches do not establish absolute novelty.
Numerical Mori-cone and conic-class facts are prior and are not credited as novel.
